from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u098/system/state/workspace/programs/task-44c4af57.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The panels are separated by a full row or column of a marker color.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if row and row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row):
            top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            if len(top) == len(bottom) and top:
                return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ra, rb)]
                        for ra, rb in zip(top, bottom)]
    for c in range(cols):
        if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid):
            left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            right = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            if c == cols - c - 1 and c > 0:
                return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ra, rb)]
                        for ra, rb in zip(left, right)]
    return []
'''
p.write_text(source)
import importlib.util
